query:
SELECT ts_headline('english', u.text, websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1),
                              'StartSel=' || $3 || ', StopSel=' || $4
                              || ', MaxWords=40, MinWords=20, MaxFragments=2, FragmentDelimiter=" … "')
                  AS "snippet!"
           FROM unnest($2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(text, n)
           ORDER BY u.n
